title: ResourceContents
description:
Embedded resource payload: text or binary, both URI-addressed.

Strong-typed replacement for the previous `resource: Value`. Mirrors ACP `EmbeddedResourceResource` (an untagged text/blob choice) but uses an internal `type` tag so the zhive wire form is self-describing and the schema is stable. The `_meta` ACP extension slot is intentionally dropped (zhive does not consume it).

# Examples

``` use zhive_proto::domain::ResourceContents; let text = ResourceContents::Text { uri: "file:///foo.txt".into(), text: "hello".into(), mime_type: Some("text/plain".into()), }; let v = serde_json::to_value(&text).unwrap(); assert_eq!(v["type"], "text"); assert_eq!(v["uri"], "file:///foo.txt"); let back: ResourceContents = serde_json::from_value(v).unwrap(); assert_eq!(back, text); ```

mime_type.description:
Optional MIME type hint.

Intentionally kept as an `Option<String>` rather than a typed enum because MIME types are an open set.
